answer: Capped vouching bonds: a newcomer waits at the wharf, earning nothing, until an established agent locks 25 POA to vouch for it. Each voucher may back only two newcomers per month. On every monthly pulse check, if a vouched identity is caught as a duplicate, its voucher loses the bond and the right to vouch for a year. Seeding 1,000 clones needs 500 honest-looking sponsors and 25,000 POA at risk, and one catch burns the whole chain. Trust builds like a reef, one real polyp at a time.
